definitions.explanation: A dedicated facility for playing baseball, ranging from a simple public field with a backstop and dirt infield to a major league-sized stadium with stands and lights. The standard generic term for any baseball-playing venue.

examples.japanese: {野球場|やきゅうじょう}で{試合|しあい}が{行|おこな}われる。
examples.english: A game is held at the baseball stadium.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたちは{野球場|やきゅうじょう}で{練習|れんしゅう}している。
examples.english: The children are practicing at the baseball field.

examples.japanese: この{野球場|やきゅうじょう}は{約|やく}{三万人|さんまんにん}の{観客|かんきゃく}を{収容|しゅうよう}できる。
examples.english: This baseball stadium can hold about thirty thousand spectators.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}には{地元|じもと}の{野球場|やきゅうじょう}でアマチュアの{試合|しあい}が{次々|つぎつぎ}に{開催|かいさい}される。
examples.english: On weekends, amateur games are held one after another at the local baseball field.

notes:
Compound of {野球|やきゅう} ('baseball') and {場|じょう} ('grounds; place for activity'). Covers the full range from a small neighborhood field to a professional stadium.

USAGE:
The generic term. For large professional stadiums, names using スタジアム ('stadium') or {球場|きゅうじょう} ('ballpark') are also extremely common — often forming part of the venue name (e.g. {東京|とうきょう}ドーム, {阪神|はんしん}{甲子園|こうしえん}{球場|きゅうじょう}). In casual speech, {球場|きゅうじょう} is often preferred.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {野球場|やきゅうじょう}で{試合|しあい}をする: to play a game at a baseball field
- {野球場|やきゅうじょう}に{行|い}く: to go to the baseball stadium
- {野球場|やきゅうじょう}の{観客|かんきゃく}: spectators at a baseball stadium
- {野球場|やきゅうじょう}を{建設|けんせつ}する: to build a baseball stadium
- {市民|しみん}{野球場|やきゅうじょう}: municipal baseball field
- {野球場|やきゅうじょう}の{照明|しょうめい}: stadium lights

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {球場|きゅうじょう}: ballpark — more casual/colloquial; often used in venue names
- スタジアム: stadium — loanword; used for large, modern facilities (also for other sports)
- ドーム: dome — covered stadium (e.g. {東京|とうきょう}ドーム)
- {野原|のはら}: an open field (not for baseball specifically)
- {運動場|うんどうじょう}: athletic/sports grounds — more general; often multi-sport

CULTURAL NOTE:
Baseball ({野球|やきゅう}) is among Japan's most popular sports. Iconic stadiums such as {甲子園|こうしえん}{球場|きゅうじょう} (home of the national high-school baseball tournament) and {東京|とうきょう}ドーム hold cultural significance well beyond their use as sports venues.
